recon_from: the user's OWN trial account if one exists
never: copy code, logo, copy, images, fonts, or content

features.name: Create a quote
features.acceptance: Create a quote with customer, >=1 line item (description, qty, unit price), tax, notes and up to 3 photos. Reusable/saved line items. Quote persists and is retrievable after reload.
features.verify: e2e: create quote -> reload -> assert all fields persisted

features.name: Quote issued as a link the customer can open without an account
features.acceptance: Quote renders as a shareable URL; opening it in a fresh incognito session shows a branded quote with an Approve control and no login prompt.
features.verify: e2e: generate link -> open in clean context -> assert quote visible + Approve present, no auth wall

features.name: Deliver the quote by SMS / WhatsApp / email
features.acceptance: Share action produces a correct deep-link/prefilled message containing the quote URL for each of the three channels.
features.verify: unit: assert generated share URLs/message bodies for sms:, whatsapp:, mailto:

features.name: One-tap quote -> invoice
features.acceptance: Approved quote converts to an invoice with identical line items, no re-entry, new sequential invoice number, and status transitions recorded.
features.verify: e2e: approve quote -> convert -> assert invoice line items equal quote line items

features.name: Partial payments and mark-as-paid
features.acceptance: Record a partial payment; remaining balance recalculates correctly; final payment flips status to paid. Overpayment is rejected or explicitly handled.
features.verify: unit+integration: payment math table incl. partial, full, rounding, overpayment

features.name: Customer list with job history
features.acceptance: Customers are auto-created from quotes; each customer shows all quotes, invoices and payments in one view.
features.verify: e2e: two quotes for one customer appear under one customer record

features.name: Offline-first core loop
features.acceptance: With the network disabled, creating a quote, converting to invoice and marking paid all succeed; on reconnect data syncs with no duplicates and no lost writes.
features.verify: e2e: Playwright context.setOffline(true) -> perform loop -> setOffline(false) -> assert exactly-once sync

features.name: Bring-your-own payment account
features.acceptance: Studio/user connects their own Stripe in test mode; an invoice can be paid end-to-end with a test card; platform takes 0% and no fee line is added.
features.verify: integration against Stripe test mode: create payment intent -> confirm test card -> assert invoice paid, assert no platform fee

features.name: Flat pricing, unlimited users and quotes
features.acceptance: Code contains no per-seat or per-quote gating; no quota enforcement path exists.
features.verify: grep/unit: assert no seat/quota checks in the codebase

features.name: Quote/invoice PDF that does not look amateur
features.acceptance: PDF renders with logo, tax breakdown, totals, terms and page-safe layout; long descriptions wrap rather than clip.
features.verify: render PDF -> assert text content + visual snapshot diff against golden
